review_comments.body: **Replay restores masked tool arguments.** With pass-through enabled, a supported `PromptProtecter` that exposes only `Protect` can now mask arguments through `ApplyPromptProtectionRules`, but the original arguments still reach the provider. `promptProtectionTexts` ignores `ToolCalls`, so an arguments-only change leaves the before/after snapshots equal. No replay check is created, and no matched rules are available to patch the raw body. The raw request then replaces the masked request. Include arguments in `promptProtectionTexts` and add an arguments-only case using `legacyPayloadPromptProtecter` to check that the protected body is kept. > **How this was verified:** The `Protect`-only path returns no matched rules, the snapshots omit arguments, and pass-through replaces the protected body without patching or checking those arguments. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Request orchestration and routing](https://app.greptile.com/-/switch-tenant?tenant=looplj&next=%2Fcustom-context%2Fknowledge-base%2Flooplj%2Faxonhub%2F-%2Fdocs%2Frequest-orchestration-and-routing.md)

Summary

Extends prompt protection to tool-call arguments and patches those arguments in OpenAI chat pass-through requests. - Prompt-protection rules now check tool-call arguments in unified requests. - OpenAI chat pass-through now masks matching tool-call arguments. One replay gap remains for supported protectors that expose only `Protect`.
